/* Small yellow laser cursor */

#laser-cursor {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  z-index: 100000;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background: #f2c94c;
  border: 1px solid #fff2a6;
  border-radius: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  box-shadow: 0 0 4px #fff3a7, 0 0 9px #f2c94c, 0 0 17px rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.85), 0 0 27px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.45);
  transition: width 0.16s ease, height 0.16s ease, opacity 0.16s ease, box-shadow 0.16s ease;
}

#laser-cursor::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.45);
  border-radius: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  animation: laser-pulse 1.25s ease-out infinite;
}

#laser-cursor.laser-hover {
  width: 11px;
  height: 11px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 6px #fff3a7, 0 0 13px #f2c94c, 0 0 25px rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.95), 0 0 38px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.55);
}

@keyframes laser-pulse {
  0% { width: 10px; height: 10px; opacity: 0.8; }
  100% { width: 27px; height: 27px; opacity: 0; }
}

@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  body.laser-cursor-enabled,
  body.laser-cursor-enabled * { cursor: none !important; }
}

.ribbon-trail {
  position: fixed;
  width: 13px;
  height: 4px;
  z-index: 99998;
  pointer-events: none;
  border-radius: 80% 15% 80% 15%;
  box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.45);
  animation: ribbon-float 0.9s ease-out forwards;
}

@keyframes ribbon-float {
  0% {
    opacity: 0.95;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(var(--start-rotation)) scale(1);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate(calc(-50% + var(--ribbon-x)), calc(-50% + var(--ribbon-y))) rotate(var(--end-rotation)) scale(0.35);
  }
}

.sakura-petal {
  position: fixed;
  width: 9px;
  height: 7px;
  z-index: 99997;
  pointer-events: none;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffd6e3, #ef9fba);
  border-radius: 90% 10% 90% 10%;
  box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(239, 159, 186, 0.5);
  animation: sakura-fall 1.15s ease-out forwards;
}

@keyframes sakura-fall {
  from {
    opacity: 0.95;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(0deg) scale(1);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate(calc(-50% + var(--petal-x)), calc(-50% + var(--petal-y))) rotate(240deg) scale(0.35);
  }
}

.paw-burst {
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 100001;
  pointer-events: none;
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1;
  filter: sepia(1) saturate(1.4) drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.7));
  animation: paw-burst-animation 0.75s ease-out forwards;
}

@keyframes paw-burst-animation {
  from {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.45) rotate(0deg);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate(calc(-50% + var(--paw-x)), calc(-50% + var(--paw-y))) scale(1.15) rotate(var(--paw-rotation));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  body::before,
  body::after { opacity: 0.2; }
  .hobby-hero { padding: 1.55rem 1.35rem; border-radius: 15px; }
  .hobby-hero p { font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.65; }
  .hobby-block { margin: 1.7rem 0; padding: 1.45rem 1.25rem 1.6rem; border-radius: 15px; }
  .hobby-block h2 { padding-right: 1.6rem; font-size: 1.42rem; }
  .game-tags { gap: 0.4rem; }
  .game-tags span { min-height: 40px; padding: 0.52rem 0.85rem; font-size: 0.88rem; border-radius: 9px; }
  .hobby-tags span { padding: 0.52rem 0.85rem; font-size: 0.9rem; }
}

@media (hover: none), (pointer: coarse) {
  #laser-cursor,
  .ribbon-trail,
  .sakura-petal,
  .paw-burst { display: none !important; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hobby-block,
  .hobby-block img,
  .game-tags span,
  .hobby-tags span { transition: none; }
  .ribbon-trail,
  .sakura-petal,
  .paw-burst { display: none !important; }
}

::: {.hobby-hero}
Outside research, my interests range from fossils, antiques, and handmade work to cars, cats, cooking, gaming, film and music. My favorite visual motifs include medieval knights, samurai, and cherry blossoms, while black, gold, and yellow are the colors I am most drawn to.
:::

:::: {.hobby-block}
## Collections & Handmade Work

I enjoy collecting objects that carry a visible sense of history, particularly fossils, antiques, and paintings. I also enjoy making things by hand, including rugs and ceramic sculptures. These objects connect history, material, and imagination in ways that I find deeply personal.

::: {layout-ncol=2}
![Part of my fossil collection](images/hobbies/fossil-collection.jpg)

![A painting from my collection](images/hobbies/collected-painting.jpg)

![A rug I made](images/hobbies/handmade-rug.jpg)

![A ceramic sculpture I made](images/hobbies/ceramic-sculpture.jpg)
:::
::::

:::: {.hobby-block}
## Favorite Motifs

I am especially drawn to medieval knights, samurai, and cherry blossoms. I like the contrast between strength and restraint, history and transience. Black, gold, and yellow are the colors I most often use as visual accents.

::: {layout-ncol=2}
![Knight display](images/hobbies/knight-display-1.jpg)

![Armor and historical objects](images/hobbies/knight-display-2.jpg)
:::
::::

:::: {.hobby-block}
## Cars & Driving

Cars are where engineering, design, history, and personality come together. Some of my favorites are the Mercedes-AMG W222 S63, Mercedes-AMG GT R, 1987 Porsche 930 Turbo, Nissan 350Z, Chevrolet Corvette C8, and Series 2 Lotus Exige S.

::: {layout-ncol=3}

:::: {.hobby-block}
## My Cats

I have three cats, each with a very different personality: Huangdou, an orange tabby; Hudou, an American Shorthair; and Xiaopofu, a Ragdoll. Together, they bring warmth, energy, and plenty of unpredictability into everyday life.

::: {layout-ncol=3}

:::

:::: {.hobby-block}
## Cooking

Cooking is one of my favorite ways to relax and experiment. I enjoy learning new techniques, recreating dishes that I have tried elsewhere, and sharing food with friends. It combines creativity with the satisfaction of producing something tangible.

<div id="laser-cursor"></div>

<script>
(function () {
  function initializeLaserCursor() {
    const laserCursor = document.getElementById("laser-cursor");
    if (!laserCursor) return;
    if (window.matchMedia("(hover: none), (pointer: coarse)").matches) return;

    document.body.classList.add("laser-cursor-enabled");

    const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    let mouseX = window.innerWidth / 2;
    let mouseY = window.innerHeight / 2;
    let laserX = mouseX;
    let laserY = mouseY;
    let lastTrailTime = 0;
    let cursorIsVisible = false;
    const ribbonColors = ["#171717", "#d4af37", "#f2c94c", "#ffe487"];

    function animateLaser() {
      laserX += (mouseX - laserX) * 0.34;
      laserY += (mouseY - laserY) * 0.34;
      laserCursor.style.left = laserX + "px";
      laserCursor.style.top = laserY + "px";
      requestAnimationFrame(animateLaser);
    }
    animateLaser();

    function createRibbon(x, y) {
      const ribbon = document.createElement("span");
      ribbon.className = "ribbon-trail";
      ribbon.style.left = x + "px";
      ribbon.style.top = y + "px";
      const horizontalMovement = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 55;
      const verticalMovement = 18 + Math.random() * 42;
      const startRotation = Math.random() * 180;
      const endRotation = startRotation + 160 + Math.random() * 220;
      ribbon.style.background = ribbonColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * ribbonColors.length)];
      ribbon.style.setProperty("--ribbon-x", horizontalMovement + "px");
      ribbon.style.setProperty("--ribbon-y", verticalMovement + "px");
      ribbon.style.setProperty("--start-rotation", startRotation + "deg");
      ribbon.style.setProperty("--end-rotation", endRotation + "deg");
      document.body.appendChild(ribbon);
      setTimeout(function () { ribbon.remove(); }, 900);
    }

    function createPetal(x, y) {
      const petal = document.createElement("span");
      petal.className = "sakura-petal";
      petal.style.left = x + "px";
      petal.style.top = y + "px";
      petal.style.setProperty("--petal-x", ((Math.random() - 0.5) * 70) + "px");
      petal.style.setProperty("--petal-y", (28 + Math.random() * 48) + "px");
      document.body.appendChild(petal);
      setTimeout(function () { petal.remove(); }, 1150);
    }

    document.addEventListener("mousemove", function (event) {
      mouseX = event.clientX;
      mouseY = event.clientY;
      if (!cursorIsVisible) {
        laserCursor.style.opacity = "1";
        cursorIsVisible = true;
      }
      if (reduceMotion) return;
      const currentTime = performance.now();
      if (currentTime - lastTrailTime > 58) {
        lastTrailTime = currentTime;
        createRibbon(mouseX, mouseY + 8);
        if (Math.random() < 0.16) createPetal(mouseX, mouseY + 8);
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener("mouseleave", function () {
      laserCursor.style.opacity = "0";
      cursorIsVisible = false;
    });

    document.addEventListener("mouseenter", function () {
      laserCursor.style.opacity = "1";
      cursorIsVisible = true;
    });

    document.addEventListener("mouseover", function (event) {
      if (event.target.closest && event.target.closest("a, button, img, .game-tags span, .hobby-tags span")) {
        laserCursor.classList.add("laser-hover");
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener("mouseout", function (event) {
      if (event.target.closest && event.target.closest("a, button, img, .game-tags span, .hobby-tags span")) {
        laserCursor.classList.remove("laser-hover");
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener("mousedown", function (event) {
      if (reduceMotion) return;
      const pawCount = 6;
      for (let index = 0; index < pawCount; index++) {
        const paw = document.createElement("span");
        paw.className = "paw-burst";
        paw.textContent = "🐾";
        paw.style.left = event.clientX + "px";
        paw.style.top = event.clientY + "px";
        const angle = (Math.PI * 2 * index / pawCount) + Math.random() * 0.35;
        const distance = 35 + Math.random() * 40;
        paw.style.setProperty("--paw-x", Math.cos(angle) * distance + "px");
        paw.style.setProperty("--paw-y", Math.sin(angle) * distance + "px");
        paw.style.setProperty("--paw-rotation", ((Math.random() - 0.5) * 100) + "deg");
        document.body.appendChild(paw);
        setTimeout(function () { paw.remove(); }, 750);
      }
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initializeLaserCursor);
  } else {
    initializeLaserCursor();
  }
})();
</script>
